products.title: Constitutional Law of India: Master Revision & Judiciary Notes
products.short_description: Exhaustive, section-by-section analysis of Articles 1 to 395 with 140+ landmark Supreme Court precedents, doctrine flowcharts, and mains model answers.
products.description:
A master study compendium prepared exclusively for State Judicial Services aspirants, UPSC Law Optional candidates, and LL.B/LL.M scholars. 

This comprehensive volume distills complex constitutional doctrines into structured, exam-oriented frameworks. It provides side-by-side comparative tables for historical constitutional developments, exhaustive coverage of Part III (Fundamental Rights), the Basic Structure Doctrine from *Kesavananda Bharati* to *Minerva Mills*, and a specialized treatise on Article 32 & 226 prerogative writs with practical drafting notes.

Every chapter concludes with previous 10 years' solved mains questions from Delhi, UP, MP, and Bihar Judiciary, accompanied by high-scoring structural templates.

products.title: New Criminal Laws Handbook: BNS, BNSS & BSA Comparative Analysis (2024-2026)
products.short_description: The definitive transition manual comparing IPC to Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, CrPC to Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, and IEA to Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam.
products.description:
India's criminal justice system has witnessed its most historic overhaul in over 160 years. This comprehensive handbook provides an authoritative, clause-by-clause comparative bridge between the colonial era penal statutes and the newly enacted criminal laws.

Includes complete concordances, section-mapping tables, highlighted substantive modifications, newly introduced offences (terrorism, organized crime, mob lynching), procedural revolutions (forensic evidence mandate, zero FIR formalization, e-summons), and electronic evidence admissibility guidelines under BSA.

products.title: Code of Civil Procedure (CPC) & Limitation Act: Visual Flowcharts & Case Notes
products.short_description: De-mystify complex civil litigation procedure. Complete with 80+ visual flowcharts, Order-Rule cheat sheets, Res Judicata doctrines, and Execution templates.
products.description:
The Code of Civil Procedure 1908 is notoriously regarded as the most intimidating procedural code for students and litigators alike. This handbook breaks down every stage of a civil suit—from institution of plaint under Order VII to summons, written statement under Order VIII, framing of issues (Order XIV), interim injunctions (Order XXXIX), and appellate mechanisms.

Features simplified visual diagrams for Section 10 (Res Sub-Judice) and Section 11 (Res Judicata), accompanied by exhaustive notes on the Law of Limitation 1963.

products.title: Judiciary Mains Master Answer-Writing Framework & Judgment Writing
products.short_description: The proprietary answer-structuring methodology that helped 70+ students clear State Judicial Services. Includes civil & criminal judgment writing blueprints.
products.description:
Clearing the Judiciary Preliminary exam tests knowledge, but clearing the Mains examination tests presentation, legal synthesis, and authoritative articulation. 

This masterclass manual contains 150+ solved high-scoring answers modeled across past papers of Delhi (DJS), Uttar Pradesh (UPPCS-J), Madhya Pradesh (MP-HJS/CJ), Haryana (HCS-J), and Rajasthan (RJS).

Includes dedicated sections for framing criminal charges under BNSS, framing civil issues under Order XIV CPC, and drafting complete criminal/civil judgments with evidence marshalling and sentencing considerations.

products.title: 500 Landmark Supreme Court Judgments Compendium (1950 - 2026)
products.short_description: Concise 1-page ratio decidendi briefs for the 500 most quoted Supreme Court judgments across Constitutional, Criminal, Property, and Corporate Jurisprudence.
products.description:
Never spend hours wading through 200-page judgments when preparing for exams or oral arguments. Each case summary is meticulously formatted into four essential sections:
1. Facts of the Case
2. Primary Legal Questions & Conflicting Precedents
3. Ratio Decidendi (Authoritative Holding of the Bench)
4. Key Obiter Dicta & Overruled Precedents.

Includes bench compositions, dissenting opinions of note, and chronological updates through October 2026.
